description: GlanceNow：会話の始まり・質問を送った時・返事が終わった時に、画面の元データを新しくする。「区切り」のスキルが動いた返事では、終わりに部屋の1行を書かせる。Python は、最初に動いた時に覚えた実体の場所を直接呼ぶ（無ければ python3 → python）

hooks.command: p=; read -r p 2>/dev/null < "${GLANCENOW_HOME:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.glancenow}/python"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null; else python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null; fi; true

p=; read -r p 2>/dev/null < "${GLANCENOW_HOME:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.glancenow}/python"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook scan 2>/dev/null; else python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook scan 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook scan 2>/dev/null; fi; true

p=; read -r p 2>/dev/null < "${GLANCENOW_HOME:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.glancenow}/python"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null; else python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null; fi; true

p=; read -r p 2>/dev/null < "${GLANCENOW_HOME:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.glancenow}/python"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook skill 2>/dev/null; else python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook skill 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook skill 2>/dev/null; fi; true

p=; read -r p 2>/dev/null < "${GLANCENOW_HOME:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.glancenow}/python"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null; else python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook 2>/dev/null; fi; true

for f in "${GLANCENOW_HOME:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.glancenow}/pending/"*; do [ -e "$f" ] && { p=; read -r p 2>/dev/null < "${GLANCENOW_HOME:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.glancenow}/python"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook stopcheck 2>/dev/null; else python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook stopcheck 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/glancenow.py" hook stopcheck 2>/dev/null; fi; }; break; done; true
